record_id.reason: Reference_Number is not unique (4919 distinct values across 5817 rows), so a full-row hash is used as the record key. Reference_Number is retained as context but does not identify a row alone.

observed_at.source: Tenders WA Contract Award Details 2023-24 Financial Year (CSV, snapshot register)

fields.reason: Column is the awarded supplier's address as a single free-text string, matching the ontology's address.full. Address is not the government buyer's address.
Samples end in a 4-digit postcode after the suburb. The trailing 4 digits are extracted and normalised. No state is stated, so address.state is not mapped.

No explicit entity-type column exists, so the suffix rule on the supplier name column is used. Names ending in a parenthesis are returned as unknown by the rule. Individuals such as Rebecca Jean Martin are not inferred as sole traders.

needs_transform.why: Trading (Legal) style text with no consistent pattern. Sometimes the parenthesis holds the registered name ('Integrity Staffing (Agility Staffing Pty Ltd)'), sometimes a person ('Crafted Comms (Rebecca Jean Martin)'), sometimes a repeated or trading name ('Hays Specialist Recruitment Pty Ltd (Hays Specialist Recruitment (Australia) Pty Ltd)'), and sometimes no parenthesis at all ('NEC Australia Pty Ltd'). Which part is the registered supplier name cannot be determined from the text, so entity.legal_name and entity.trading_name are not mapped. A split or extract transform that resolves the ordering would be needed.

source_reliability_basis: Publisher is a WA state government procurement register (Treasury and Finance), which is authoritative on the fact of an award and the awarded supplier as entered by the buyer. Supplier names and addresses are self-reported by the buyer or supplier and are not checked against ASIC or ABR, so identity and address are moderate. Classification is low because UNSPSC codes describe procured goods and services, not supplier industry. Contact is low because no contact data is provided.
